store_abstract_notes: The spec shows AbstractVersionedStore with exists/write methods. KeywordIndexStore and CodeSampleIndexStore have complex read() logic with JOINs that differs significantly. The abstract class should NOT try to abstract read() — only exists(), write() (transactional delete+insert), and deleteVersion(). The read() stays concrete in each subclass. Important: Feature 43 already created TransactionTemplate — consider whether AbstractVersionedStore should use it.
multiKeywordBoost_note: The multi-keyword boost is applied in SearchService AFTER calling computeMatchingScore. It should STAY in SearchService — do NOT move it into the scorer.
